terms.label: Quantum mechanics
terms.definition: The fundamental theory describing physical properties of nature at the scale of atoms and subatomic particles.

terms.label: Wave-particle duality
terms.definition: The concept that every particle or quantum entity may be described as either a particle or a wave.

terms.label: Quantum superposition
terms.definition: A fundamental principle stating that a physical system exists partly in all its possible states simultaneously.

terms.label: Quantum entanglement
terms.definition: A physical phenomenon occurring when a group of particles are generated or interact in a way such that the quantum state of each particle cannot be described independently.

terms.label: Quantum measurement
terms.definition: The process by which a quantum state collapses to a definite eigenstate upon observation.

terms.label: Heisenberg uncertainty principle
terms.definition: The principle stating that the more precisely the position of a particle is determined, the less precisely its momentum can be known.

terms.label: Hilbert space
terms.definition: A complete inner product space that serves as the state space in quantum mechanics.

terms.label: Wavefunction
terms.definition: A mathematical description of the quantum state of an isolated quantum system.

terms.label: Schrödinger equation
terms.definition: A linear partial differential equation that governs the wave function of a quantum system.

terms.label: Quantum operator
terms.definition: A mathematical operator used in quantum mechanics to represent physical observables.

terms.label: Hamiltonian operator
terms.definition: The operator corresponding to the total energy of a quantum system.

terms.label: Momentum operator
terms.definition: The operator corresponding to linear momentum in quantum mechanics.

terms.label: Position operator
terms.definition: The operator corresponding to the position of a particle in quantum mechanics.

terms.label: Eigenvalue
terms.definition: A scalar associated with a linear transformation such that the transformation scales a vector by that scalar.

terms.label: Eigenstate
terms.definition: A quantum state that corresponds to a definite value of an observable.

terms.label: Quantum harmonic oscillator
terms.definition: The quantum-mechanical analog of the classical harmonic oscillator.

terms.label: Pauli exclusion principle
terms.definition: The principle that two identical fermions cannot occupy the same quantum state simultaneously.

terms.label: Quantum tunneling
terms.definition: A quantum mechanical phenomenon where a particle passes through a potential energy barrier.

terms.label: Spin
terms.definition: An intrinsic form of angular momentum carried by elementary particles.

terms.label: Density matrix
terms.definition: A matrix that describes the statistical state of a quantum system, including mixed states.
